nodes.equation: same steady wire model as CALC-F1-WIRES, 28 AWG, pod still air, f_pair for the ribbon; per conductor: 5 V I_5V / n_5V, Vx I_stall / n_Vx, GND (I_5V + I_stall) / n_GND; I_5V = CL-F3-5V-REQ (2 x the FC 5 V load), I_stall = CL-F1-SERVO-STALL-BUS (both servos stalled, D-74)

nodes.title: ESC input capacitors: ripple current, ripple voltage, spike, can temperature (X2814 V3 + 11x8E, 75 A)
nodes.equation: square-wave ESC input current between 0 and I_ph at duty D: I_cap,rms = I_ph sqrt(D (1 - D)) <= 0.5 I_ph, all of it in the added cans (the LANRC's own caps and the leads not credited); limiter: I_ph = winding at the band edge, D = I_bat / I_ph; hover, heavier motor: 0.5 x I_wind,hover x 2s/(1+s); single-motor transient at the static cap: I_ph = 49.3 A, D = 40 / 49.3. Per can / n. Permissible per can = I0 x k_freq x k_temp (maker multipliers). Thermal-window RMS over tau = R_th C_th with t_lim at the limiter + the transient, rest hover. V_pp = I_ph (k_esr ESR / n) + I_ph D (1 - D) / (f n C). Spike = I_bat sqrt(L_lead / (n C)) + I_ph k_esr ESR / n; V_peak = V_full + spike + V_pp / 2. T_core = T_amb + R_th I^2 k_esr ESR

R5: + one XT30U per branch (2.4 mOhm, D-74), +0.6 mOhm on the equivalent; P:electrical.r_ext_mohm (A1) follows (CR-F1-24).

nodes.note: R8 corrected limit: the 2 % was an F1 design target with no physical basis; the physical limit is E1's thrust allowance CL-E1-DROP-ALLOW (set at the limiter, so conservative at the lower hover current). For J6 / A2 review

nodes.title: Voltage drop pack to the farthest ESC at the 80 A limiter
nodes.how: T-F1-DROP scaled with the XT30U plugs in; stand log at full throttle. Go to 14 AWG on the right-hand leads only if the measured drop costs real thrust (WB-11).
nodes.note: CDR-03 / CDR-EL-04 (2026-11-13): the limit is back, derived from E1's thrust need: CL-E1-DROP-ALLOW is the limiter-current drop at which R-HOVER-TW is just held (worst pack T/W 1.6, fresh 2.0) on the more pessimistic of E1's two motor bounds. Comparing the FARTHEST branch with it is conservative: E1's limit is for the equivalent path of all four. D-74 accepted the XT30U over F1's 5 % guideline (WB-11); R5 then removed the limit instead of replacing it. The guideline is exceeded by CL-F1-DROP-OVER-5PCT and stays F1's design target.

nodes.title: Limiter-current drop above the 5 % guideline (WB-11), percentage points
nodes.how: Information: T-F1-DROP. Positive = the guideline is exceeded.
nodes.note: No limit: WB-11 makes 5 % a guideline and D-74 accepted the XT30U. The hard limit is on CL-F1-DROP-PEAK.

nodes.title: Wire heat runs
nodes.procedure: Bench supply (>= 40 A) + load; built power stack (10 AWG jumpers, power board) in a closed pod mock-up at 30 A, 16 AWG pair in a taped XPS groove at 8.4 A, two pairs through a 50 mm straw at 8.4 A each, each 10 min; K-type thermocouples mid-lead under foam tape; then 50 A for 2 s on the 16 AWG. Pass: rise <= 10 degC steady (jumpers: above their joints), <= 30 degC peak, pack leads <= 20 degC.

nodes.title: AS150U and XT60H heat runs
nodes.procedure: AS150U: 38 A for 10 min, then 75 A for 10 s; XT60H: 10 A 10 min, then 40 A 2 s and 50 A 2 s; IR on the housings; rise <= 30 degC.

nodes.title: Path resistance
nodes.procedure: 20 A load step from the pack; meter across pack terminals and across one ESC's pads; R = dV/dI. Pass: drop <= 2 % at 30 A; R_ext <= CL-E1-REXT-ALLOW.

nodes.title: Current sensor calibration
nodes.procedure: Clamp meter on the main lead at 5, 15, 25, 30 A (motors on the restrained frame); set BATT_AMP_PERVLT so BAT.Curr is within +/-1.1 % at 25-30 A (D-157); record the value for F4. Voltage: BATT_VOLT_MULT within 0.1 V of a meter at the battery pads (BOARD-CHECK.md step 8); the +/-0.5 % voltage line of D-161c is dropped with the Lua spin cap (D-173b, static Q_M_SPIN_MAX).

nodes.title: Servo stall current and rail voltage
nodes.procedure: Each servo blocked at full deflection 2 s on the power-board servo BEC (6 V jumper), meter in series: pass <= 2.0 A per servo (the factor-2 limit on the 8 A BEC); both together: Vx >= 5.8 V at the servo and FC 5 V >= 4.8 V (as BOARD-CHECK.md step 7, with the real servos).

nodes.title: Anti-spark behaviour
nodes.procedure: Scope on the bus while plugging the AS150U slowly; bus >= 95 % before the main pins close; no spark marks after 20 plug cycles.

nodes.title: ESC supply ripple and cap heating
nodes.procedure: Stand, one station, Bluejay 48 kHz: current probe on one cap pair's legs and scope at the ESC pads at hover power 120 s, then a 10 s limiter punch, a single-motor step to the 0.81 cap and a throttle chop. Pass: per-can RMS <= CL-F1-CAP-RATING, can rise <= 15 K after 120 s (IR), <= 1.0 V p-p, no spike above 21 V.
